advice.headline: Stay the course

moves.text: Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.5 points a week) and drop Matt Hibner.

reasons: You're 15-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 28%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 36% of the time with the first-round bye and 24% without it. You get the bye in 33% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 8 contenders (179.7 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (12th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 28%, 27%, 28%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.
We tested the best fair trade with 6 teams and none clearly raises your title chance beyond the simulation's margin (about 2 points).
Re-check before the deadline (3 weeks left): injuries change this quickly.
